pkgmetadata.longdescription: jayofelony's fork of bettercap, tracked on its pcapng branch: the extra commits keep a handshake pcapng file's section open across bettercap restarts, which is what pwnagotchi's handshake accounting expects. Packaged under a fork-specific name because upstream bettercap has moved on to 2.41.7 and net-analyzer/bettercap should stay available for it. Installs /usr/bin/bettercap.
